page_title: 本地配置工具Mxc_Config配置局域网设备参数
page_content:
#### 前提条件：
- 设备和电脑在同一个局域网段下，电脑能ping通设备本地IP地址

#### 操作步骤：
1. 点击下载[MmxConfig](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=025cf1442dcea388ae2941e15105009f "[MmxConfig_V1.0.10.rar")配置工具，解压安装后点击“Mxc_Config” 打开工具![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=defe35a6af2c5dc8e58fa0bde53b14df)
1. 点击Search搜索局域网内设备
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=545fb5ee726a12114c60424dbc3a83fc)
1. 选择要查看配置的设备
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=93525305df96d01158e9bd3985ae3081)
1. 左边是一些常见功能配置项，填入参数后点击右侧“set”按钮设置保存
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=58165b6a384d5a508dbdf8a971a8f2de)
1. 右边是自定义配置命令，点击发送
 ps:常见参数指令参考[常见配置参数指令](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/web/#/11/74 "常见配置参数指令")和[常见查询参数指令](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/web/#/11/75 "常见查询参数指令")
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4658c6e0621d85ddba71e1b6a4ee944f)
1. 获取发送后反馈的结果
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0fc0490a7a3fc87d0d02f6baa4848734)
7.可点击清除下面自定义命令窗口和响应窗口的内容
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6880341ee4318c6e26bafdad8bf873b2)
